label: CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_1: causal capacity
term: causal power as capacity or disposition
definition: A bearer has the ability to bring about an effect in a selected respect under suitable conditions, whether or not it is exercising that ability. Possession does not by itself assert present transmission, an intrinsic source, finite grounding, or an explanation of the bearer’s existence. The suitable conditions and the relevant effect must be specified in an application, not defined retrospectively as whatever yields success.
note: Stipulative primitive interpretation, not an attributed source reading. The Capacity interface preserves situation, bearer and specified effect/respect indices; possesses is primitive. #319 Profile does not encode unexercised capacity. #741 retains its original cap parameter and DEF-BORROWED-POWER-PROFILE. The new eventProfile adapter reads possesses through explicit scenario/situation, event/bearer and event/respect maps. FiberAgreement requires agreement whenever all three mapped indices agree; the proposed factorization certificate shows exactly when an event profile can be recovered from those indices. Without agreement, fromEvents retains event identity alongside respect instead of claiming factorization. The generic root-route hasCausalPower parameter remains unchanged: fromBearer embeds it with one selected respect and bearerProfile recovers it. None of these consumers is silently rewritten to use this declaration. PowerRequired remains the separate actual exercise-to-capacity assumption; activation and the converse are not added. The prior capOccurs/capAll and PowerOmission controls are reused, not new rival defeats. See docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md, Indexed capacity adapter. The adapter certificate passes focused Lean, binding, Comparator and NanoDa checks; application warrant and independent semantic challenge remain separate.

formal_gap.meaning: possesses w b r means bearer b has the ability for the specified effect or respect r in situation w, whether or not that ability is exercised. The indices distinguish powers of one bearer and variations between situations. This is an explicit primitive interpretation, not a reduction to occurrence, a successful outcome or an intrinsic-source marker.
examples: A charged battery can retain a selected capacity while disconnected; its exercise additionally requires an appropriate circuit. This is an illustration of the distinction, not a new empirical certificate.
The existing BorrowedExercise profiles capOccurs and capAll assign different capacity conditions to the same exercise. The adapter must preserve their difference.
exclusions: Possession alone asserts neither activation nor occurrence, an actual transmission edge, an underived source, finite grounding, or uncaused esse.

Different events of one bearer need not have the same capacity when their specified effects or respects differ. Same bearer and respect do not justify collapsing situations with different capacity assignments.
open_obligations: Defend the intended capacity, effect/respect and situation interpretation in an application; specify activation conditions separately.

Use explicit index maps and FiberAgreement for a common-bearer/respect representation; arbitrary event profiles need not satisfy it. Values outside the mapped image are not determined by correspondence.
No source claim or root-route premise is established. The existing consumers retain their raw parameters until an explicit, reviewed integration adopts an adapter.
Independent semantic challenge and final integration CI remain required; the generic consumers have not been migrated to this interface.
